[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Eight maids a-milking,</span>]{.gift day="8"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Seven swans a-swimming,</span>]{.gift day="7"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Six geese a-laying,</span>]{.gift day="6"}

[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">E</span>Two turtle </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>doves,</span>]{.gift day="2"}
